resources.string: Missing something? Tell us and we will look into it. If it is a good idea, it may arrive in a future version.
Only what you write and the app version are sent, without your name or your workouts. Do not include personal data.
Thanks! Your suggestion has been sent
You have sent many suggestions today. Try again tomorrow.
Write a bit more so the idea is clear.
Could not send. Check your connection and try again.
You have not sent any suggestions yet.

If you send a suggestion from Settings (light bulb icon), the text you write, the app version and a random identifier of this installation (to show you the replies) are sent. They are stored in a Google Apps Script service and in a private GitHub repository of the developer, only to study the idea. Your name, account and workouts are not sent. It is only sent when you tap Send.
